qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Regulatory cGMP switching barriers and tech-transfer stickiness exist, but heavy plant capex and competitive small-molecule CDMO market keep 5-year median ROIC ~8-9%, well below the 12% threshold.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Reliable Swiss CDMO with regulatory switching barriers in API synthesis and sterile fill-finish, but high plant capex and competitive small-molecule pricing keep 5-year median ROIC below 9%, failing the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Reported Core EBITDA margins run ~21-23% and Core EBIT margins ~15-16%, but multi-year post-tax GAAP ROIC averages only ~8-9% due to heavy tangible capital bases (plants in Minden, Hameln, Pennsville) and working capital intensity. Fails 12% ROIC requirement.
